name: Warm White Snow Ball Fairy Lights , Waterproof Decorative Fairy Lights Set of 28 Pieces
description:
Type: LED string lights

Lamp shape: Snow ball / Globe

Light color: Warm white

Length: Approximately 14 feet

Style: Romantic, perfect for creating cozy atmospheres

Waterproof for indoor and outdoor use

Wire material: Copper wire

Lamp material: PVC plastic

Power supply: Current driven, Input voltage: 220V

Applications:
Perfect for gardens, living rooms, dining rooms, bedrooms, weddings, parties, Valentine’s Day, Halloween, Christmas, and more. Ideal for night lighting, party decoration, and creating a warm, festive atmosphere.

Description:
Illuminate your space with these charming LED snow ball string lights. Designed for both indoor and outdoor use, they are waterproof and durable. With a romantic warm white glow and versatile 14-foot length, these string lights are ideal for adding ambiance to any room or special occasion.
